commands.tpmaster.help:
Usage: `/tpm <operation> [<arg1> <arg2> ...]`.
`/tpm a` - accept the teleport request you just received.
`/tpm d` - deny the teleport request you just received.
`/tpm w [<distance> [<mustOnLand>]]` - randomly teleport you <distance> blocks away (disable <mustOnLand> to accept positions in water).
`/tpm r <target> [ a | i ]` - create a teleport request that you ask(a) <target> if you can teleport where <target> is, or you invite(i) <target> to come to where you are.
`/tpm sp` - teleport to shared spawn point.
`/tpm sh [<index>]` - set your current location as your home <index>.
`/tpm h [<index>]` - teleport to your home <index>.
`/tpm back` - teleport back to your last death point.
`/tpm de h [<index>]` - remove your home <index>.
`/tpm de b` - remove your last death point.
`/tpm sos` - show help information.
